theorem_rows.name: one_step_modulus_barrier
theorem_rows.statement: For all current window-miss atoms, word_modulus exceeds phase width and the word has a single window representative.

theorem_rows.name: endpoint_distance_implied_by_modulus_barrier
theorem_rows.statement: The endpoint distance inequality follows from the one-step modulus barrier and actual mod-15 residue absence.

theorem_rows.name: global_modulus_dominates_phase_width
theorem_rows.statement: A global proof must show every non-structural formal-unit cover word has modulus larger than its fixed phase window width.

theorem_rows.name: small_modulus_overlap_pdec
theorem_rows.statement: If word_modulus is not larger than the window width, the possible actual-residue overlap must be certified by PDEC/ColumnCRT.

plain_conclusion: 本步把 Q=15 窗口错位的端点距离不等式进一步压缩为一跳模数屏障。当前 49 个错位原子全部满足：覆盖词进程在 phase 窗口内只有一个代表、该代表不是 actual P 的 mod 15 残基，且 word_modulus M 大于 phase_width W。于是沿同一覆盖词进程要到达 actual 残基至少平移一个 M，而一个 M 已超过整个窗口宽度，故命中点必在窗口外。当前最小 M-W 为 45，最小 M/W 为 1.974359。全局剩余变成证明 formal-unit 族中非结构冲突覆盖词均满足 M>W，或把 M<=W 的重叠族送入 PDEC。

decision_rows.meaning: 当前全部窗口错位原子都由 M>W 的一跳模数屏障解释。
端点距离守门项已化为 word_modulus 与 phase_width 的比较。
尚未证明任意 formal-unit 非结构冲突覆盖词都满足 M>W。
若 M<=W，则需对可能重叠给出 PDEC/ColumnCRT 排斥。
本步关闭当前端点距离计算层，但全局行/列命题仍未无条件闭合。
